_comment: The UI test groups of ui.yml, one job each (read by .github/scripts/ui_groups.py, which also makes the job matrix).
only / skip: 'Class' or 'Class/testMethod' of AlbumistUITests, separated by spaces (-only-testing / -skip-testing).
device: pro (the image's iPhone Pro) or se (the small iPhone), see .github/toolchain.json.
flow-other is 'everything the other groups do not run', so a new test class always runs somewhere and no test runs twice
(test_ui_tests.py GroupTests checks every UI test against the groups). Keep its skip list in step with the others.

The order is the start order: large-library first (TestFlight, three at a time, starts it at once; a pull request's run leaves it out), then the longest in a full run: accessibility, contrast, other flows, device, flow-full. Since 27.11. a pull request's full run has four groups beside CI's one macOS job, five Macs, the account's limit: all start at once (max-parallel 4 in ui.yml); the group contrast (after_core) follows CI's macOS job on its Mac (job ui-late). In a TestFlight run (max-parallel 3) large-library, accessibility and other flows run first and device and flow-full follow.

A change here changes the test fingerprint of the group that changed (ui_groups.py), so that group runs again. Since 27.11. large-library comes first (the longest; a TestFlight run, three at a time, starts it at once); a pull request's run leaves it out and starts device-flows, device and other flows first.
budget_min: minutes for the group's test passes (ui_tests.py budget_check); over it the run shows a warning, never red. Report-only, so not in the fingerprint.
Measured in TestFlight run 44461253154 (19.11.): device 62, flow-full 12, flow-other 52, accessibility 20, contrast 15 min (the step Run UI tests).

Rebalanced 20.11. (tempo plan): DeviceConditionUITests 05, 07, 08 left other flows and 11 left device conditions for the new group device-flows; quick runs measured before: other flows 55.8, device 43.3 min (job, median since 18.11.).

Rebalanced 21.11. by the full UI run 44828248004 (test minutes): other flows 47.2, device-flows 36.3, accessibility 22.8, device 21.0, contrast 9.3, flow-full 8.7. AlbumistFlowUITests/test1b (11.6) left other flows for flow-full: other flows about 36, flow-full about 20. The small gate (flow-full and contrast) grows by those 11.6 minutes.

Rebalanced 26.11. (runs since 24.11., step Run UI tests): other flows 42-74 (median 48), device-flows 41-48, device 25-35, accessibility 17-32, flow-full 22-31, contrast 12-20 min. test1c (6.8 min in 45690592821) left other flows for device.

Rebalanced 27.11. (speed first, full UI run 45865545486 of PR #26, test minutes: other flows 43.0, device-flows 42.7 of which test11 26.8, device 26.0, accessibility 22.7, flow-full 16.4, contrast 11.1; setup before the first test 5-13 min per group): test11 and the tap-through sweep test3 form large-library, which runs before uploads, at night and by hand, not in a pull request's run (pull_requests false); flow tests 4, 5 and 7 moved from other flows to device-flows. Expected test minutes per pull request group: device-flows 28.2, other flows 26.1, device 26.0, accessibility 22.7, flow-full 16.4, contrast 11.1 (178 to 130 in all).

Four groups 27.11. (Macs: six groups and CI's macOS job asked for seven of the account's five Macs, so two jobs waited 10-30 min; full UI runs 45939666948 and 45920259957 of PR #31, test minutes per run: device-flows 25.5/23.7, device 24.1/26.0, other flows 23.4/23.0, flow-full 24.6/19.7, accessibility 20.3/22.1, contrast 7.4/9.2; job minus test minutes 5-9 per group). device-flows was split up: DeviceConditionUITests 07 and 08 to device, 05 and AlbumistFlowUITests test5 and test7 back to other flows (where they ran before 20.11. and 27.11.), AlbumistFlowUITests test4 to flow-full. contrast became the second phase of accessibility (contrast_only: ui_tests.py erases the small iPhone after tests 1-4 and switches Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency on before test5, which meets a fresh simulator as in its own job). Expected test minutes: other flows 34.1/31.6, flow-full 32.5/28.4, device 31.0/32.5, accessibility 27.7/31.3 plus 2-5 min for the erase and boot between its phases; job minutes about 37-47.

After core 27.11. evening (full UI run 45973048317 of PR #33, job minutes: accessibility 45 with 5 min erase and boot and 8 min test5, device 43.5, other flows 43.3, flow-full 30.5; Locked test7 took 345 instead of 111 s because flow test5 and test7 before it had used up the suggestions, so it took plans back first): contrast is its own group again, but with after_core: in a run where CI's macOS job (core-macos, 12-14 min) runs, ui.yml starts it in the job ui-late after that job, on the Mac it frees, so a run never asks for more than five Macs at once and the accessibility group loses the erase. Elsewhere (TestFlight, by hand quick, night) it is an ordinary group of the matrix. AlbumistFlowUITests test5 and test7 and DeviceConditionUITests/test03 to flow-full, DeviceConditionUITests/test08 to other flows. Expected job minutes: other flows about 37, flow-full about 38, device about 38, accessibility about 31, contrast about 15 after core-macos (ends about minute 30).

groups.title: large library and tap-through sweep (before an upload and at night)
groups._why: Rebuild stage 4 bundle (owner's decision of 26.11.2026, 'alles wie empfohlen', plan section 4: test11 'nur nachts und vor Upload', test3 'nur nachts'; speed first, 27.11.): DeviceConditionUITests/test11 (large library, 26.8 min) and AlbumistFlowUITests/test3 (tap-through sweep, 4.7 min) of the full UI run 45865545486. Not part of a pull request's UI run or its verdict (pull_requests false): the list sizes of a large library are checked on Linux for every change (ListBoundaryTests, ListBoundaryStoreTests: 0 to 50,000 photos), and the 10,000-photo stress pass runs before every upload. It runs in every TestFlight run with the big gate (which checks every group, this one too; the small and the fast gate check only their own), in ui.yml's nightly run on main, and when asked for by hand.

groups.title: accessibility (small iPhone)
groups._why: AccessibilityUITests 1-4 on a small iPhone (SE, 375 pt) with Reduce Motion; test1 first on the freshly booted simulator. These tests fail on findings. test5 (Increase Contrast) is the group contrast (27.11. evening; for a few hours on 27.11. it was a second phase of this group on an erased simulator, ui_tests.py --contrast-only, which costs this group 5 min of erase and boot).

groups.title: contrast (small iPhone)
groups._why: AccessibilityUITests test5 on its own small iPhone with Reduce Motion, Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency switched on before the first launch; the test onboards by itself (onboardAndSeed). Its own job since 16.11. (UI run 43906501407). after_core (27.11. evening): where CI's macOS job runs in the same run (full runs of pull requests and runs by hand on branches), ui.yml starts this group in the job ui-late after that job, on the Mac it frees; the group's tests and fingerprint do not change by that (report-only key).

groups.title: other flows, purchase and search
groups._why: Every other UI test except the accessibility tests: flow test1d, test6 and the remove-photo test, locked purchase, search, map prototype, and DeviceConditionUITests test05 (undo when iOS declines) and test08 (removed album and undo; from device on 27.11. evening). Flow test5 and test7 went to flow-full on 27.11. evening: before the locked purchase test they used up the demo library's suggestions, and it had to take plans back first (345 instead of 111 s). 1c runs in device, 4 in flow-full, the tap-through sweep test3 in large-library. Each brings the app to an onboarded demo library by itself (UITestOnboarding).

groups.title: device conditions
groups._why: The device-condition switches (App/Albumist/Platform/UITestSwitches.swift) on the Pro simulator. A test that resets the photo access asks the Mac to give it back (UI_HOST_GRANT_PHOTOS, answered by ui_tests.py). Every DeviceConditionUITests test sets itself up (fast start, demo library), so any of them runs in any group. test05 runs in other flows, test11 in large-library; test12 is the stress test and skips itself here (ui-stress.yml). AlbumistFlowUITests/test1c (undo from the history, onboards by itself) moved here from other flows on 26.11. test07 (interrupted plan, continue and undo) and test08 (removed album and undo) came from the group device-flows on 27.11. (four groups; device-flows ended). On 27.11. evening test08 went to other flows and test03 to flow-full (balance after the first four-group run).

groups.title: full flow, video, atlas and library
groups._why: Onboarding, demo library, plan and the sorting-show video (test1), then atlas, library and search on the library test1 made (test1b, 11.6 min; it ran after test1 in one group before 16.11.). test1b moved here from other flows on 21.11.: in the full UI run 44828248004 other flows took 47.2 test minutes, the most of any group, this group 8.7. PerformanceUITests (21.11., report only: start, scrolling, and in full runs the analysis, about 8 min) run last here, on the library test1 made. AlbumistFlowUITests/test4 (decisions come back after a rebuild, about 8 min, may be the first on a fresh simulator or run on a prepared one) came from the group device-flows on 27.11. (four groups): it runs after test1b and before PerformanceUITests (classes and methods in alphabetical order), so the speed report measures the library test1 made after test4's rebuild. On 27.11. evening flow test5 (interrupted plan, 3.3 min) and test7 (personal place, 1.2 min) came from other flows and DeviceConditionUITests/test03 (background expiry, 2.8 min) from device; they run after test4 and before PerformanceUITests (class order: AlbumistFlowUITests, DeviceConditionUITests, PerformanceUITests), each sets itself up.
